subject.title: Tool outputs sometimes render as image attachments and become unreadable to the agent

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99756 be allowed to close this broad tool-output placeholder issue, or should it only reference the issue while remaining projection cases stay tracked?
rationale: The candidate PR is narrow and promising, but the issue discussion includes broader symptoms than the PR's mixed text/media provider branch, so maintainer intent is needed for closure scope after merge.

options.title: Keep Broad Issue Open
options.body: Land the narrow fix if ready, but retarget the PR body to reference this issue and keep the broader tracker open until full live payload proof or narrower follow-ups exist.

options.title: Close With Candidate PR
options.body: Keep the closing reference if maintainers decide the remaining reports are duplicates, already fixed elsewhere, or should become separate new issues after this PR lands.

options.title: Hold For Full Proof
options.body: Pause the fix until a live affected-session model-submitted payload capture proves the candidate covers the whole cluster end to end.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Issue Open
recommendation.body: Land the narrow fix if ready, but retarget the PR body to reference this issue and keep the broader tracker open until full live payload proof or narrower follow-ups exist.
